content.title: How to watch Texas A&M vs. Houston men’s basketball: Second Round TV channel and streaming options for March 21
content.text: The No. 2 seed Houston Cougars (29-6) take on the No. 10 seed Texas A&M Aggies (22-11) with a Sweet 16 berth up for grabs on Saturday at Paycom Center.How to watch Texas A&M Aggies vs. Houston Cougars Venue: Paycom Center Time: 6:10 p.m. ET TV: TNT Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. Texas A&M vs. Houston odds Spread: Houston -10.5 (-105), Texas A&M +10.5 (-110) Favorite Moneyline: Houston -565 Underdog Moneyline: Texas A&M +405 Total: 143.5 Total Over Odds: -108 Total Under Odds: -112 Odds provided by BetMGM.Stats to know Houston outscores opponents by 14.8 points per game (scoring 77.2 per game to rank 144th in college basketball while allowing 62.4 per outing to rank second in college basketball) and has a +517 scoring differential overall. Houston hits 8.8 three-pointers per game (101st in college basketball), 2.0 more than its opponents (6.8). Texas A&M’s +274 scoring differential (outscoring opponents by 8.3 points per game) is a result of putting up 87 points per game (12th in college basketball) while giving up 78.7 per outing (310th in college basketball). Texas A&M makes 10.7 three-pointers per game (15th in college basketball) at a 36.2% rate (51st in college basketball), compared to the 8.2 per game its opponents make, at a 32% rate.
